title: Redirects
description: Send visitors and search engines from old URLs to new ones. Your site asks NodePress where a path should go via GET /api/redirects/resolve.
forbidden: Only editors and admins can manage redirects.
empty: No redirects yet. Add one, or import a CSV with from,to,status columns.
openTarget: Open target in a new tab
deleteDescription: Visitors to {from} will get a 404 instead.
autoHint: When a published entry’s slug changes, NodePress adds a 301 from its old path automatically (turn off with <mono>REDIRECTS_ON_SLUG_CHANGE=false</mono>). Paths are matched without case; a query string only matches when it is part of the source.

dialog.description: Loops and chains of more than 5 redirects are refused.
dialog.fromHint: A path on your site, e.g. /old-page. Add ?query only to match that exact query.
dialog.toHint: A path on your site (/new-page) or a full URL (https://…).

import.title: Import redirects
import.description: Review of <mono>{file}</mono>. Rows are added or update the redirect with the same source; nothing is saved if any row has a problem.
import.errors: {count, plural, one {# problem — fix it and import again} other {# problems — fix them and import again}}
import.apply: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to import} one {Import # redirect} other {Import # redirects}}
